title.zh: 美参议员Lummis：《CLARITY法案》拟推动加密企业与联邦执法机构直接共享情报
title.en: 美参议员Lummis：《CLARITY法案》拟推动加密企业与联邦执法机构直接共享情报

current_state.zh: Senator Cynthia Lummis highlighted that the CLARITY Act would create a pilot program for crypto companies to share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, citing the rapid cross-chain movement of stolen funds as motivation.
current_state.en: Senator Cynthia Lummis highlighted that the CLARITY Act would create a pilot program for crypto companies to share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, citing the rapid cross-chain movement of stolen funds as motivation.
